description: Amphitheater turns a set of percentage-based KPIs into a single radial view shaped like a stadium. Each category becomes a segment radiating from the center, and each segment fills across concentric levels according to its value — so a report consumer sees the whole scorecard in one shape rather than reading a table row by row. Strong areas fill outward; weak ones stay short. That contrast is the point: instead of comparing numbers, you compare a silhouette. A balanced scorecard reads as a full ring, an uneven one as a lopsided arc, and the gap is obvious before anyone reads a label. Built for performance scorecards, maturity assessments, OKR and target tracking, survey and competency profiles, and any place a group of metrics is measured on a common 0–100% scale. Key features Plot your categories as radial segments around a shared center, with clear readability up to 20 categories Configure the number of concentric levels to match your scoring scale Place a custom logo at the center, or use the center to display a headline KPI Compare completion and contribution across categories without a legend or axis Full support for cross-filtering and cross-highlighting with other visuals on the page Format-pane control over categories, levels, and center content, with settings persisted in the report
